messages.subject: Michael | Saudi & GCC Executive Profile | Government Relations, ESG & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Patrick,

I am sharing my profile for senior Saudi and wider GCC leadership mandates where government relations, ESG, corporate affairs, regulated-sector experience and strategic stakeholder leadership intersect.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My remit spans senior government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, strategic partnerships, compliance coordination and executive communications for a major gold-mining operation.

Across 12+ years, I have also worked in regulated financial services and commercial operations. Your leadership of Odgers' Financial Services and Technology practice in the Middle East, together with your prior Public Investment Fund talent leadership and experience across Riyadh and Dubai, makes this a particularly relevant introduction.

I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Head, Country Director and VP-track mandates across External Affairs, Government Relations, Corporate Affairs, ESG, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, Regulatory Strategy and Country Leadership. Saudi Arabia is my first GCC priority, followed by the UAE.

I have attached my GCC-focused executive CV for confidential consideration. I am internationally mobile and available on 30 days' notice.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
